title: Deployment Readiness
subtitle: Configuration readiness checks for services that affect hosted and self-hosted reliability. This is not a live canary.
byokStable: A stable server key is configured.
byokEphemeral: This instance uses temporary keys. Configure a stable key for multiple instances and persistence across restarts.
byokMissing: No stable BYOK key is configured.
apiProofEnabled: High-cost API routes require short-lived request proof.
apiProofEphemeral: Request proof uses a temporary instance key. Restarting requires a new session; multiple instances need a stable key.
apiProofMissing: Hosted request proof needs a stable BYOK server key.
apiProofLocal: Request proof is disabled in local mode.
proxyHeadersTrusted: Trusted proxy headers are enabled for per-client rate limits.
proxyHeadersUntrusted: Protected APIs use request-proof sessions for rate limits. Public bootstrap routes share a deployment bucket without trusted proxy headers.
proxyHeadersLocal: Proxy client identity is not required in local mode.
storesShared: Rate limit, document job, and plugin registry stores use shared storage.
storesMemory: One or more memory stores are in use; this is only suitable for local or single-instance deployments.
storesMissingHosted: API rate limits can fall back to instance memory. Document jobs and custom plugin registries still require shared storage; multiple instances need shared rate limits too.
defaultModelReady: A usable model source is available.
defaultModelMissing: No server or local model source is configured.
searchReady: Search is available through server defaults or local settings.
searchReadyServer: Search is available through the server default.
searchReadyPublic: Public Firecrawl is called directly from this browser.
searchReadyClient: Search is available through the saved {provider} credential.
searchReadySelfHosted: Search is available through the self-hosted {provider} endpoint.
runtimeUnknown: Live deployment health is unknown because the health endpoint could not be reached.
ragReady: Knowledge retrieval or document parsing is available.
ragMissing: RAG and document parsing are not configured.
voiceReady: Speech services are available through server defaults or local settings.
pluginsReady: At least one plugin is installed locally.
pluginsRegistryMissingHosted: Hosted custom plugins need a shared server registry.
